cohort: 139 Taiwanese pregnant women who elected cesarean section
finding: Three distinct sleep-disturbance trajectories were identified (stable poor sleep, progressively worse sleep, and persistently poor sleep), and these were associated with BMI and psychological well-being up to 6 months after elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study focused on sleep disturbance trajectories in women considering elective cesarean section and did not compare different modes of delivery.
